author: InsanePenguin
quote:
This game has a boring gameplay with cringy tasks. Incessant cutscenes and animations constantly destroy the gameplay flow and immersion.  

The open world feels empty and highly restrictive.  

The story is boring and overwritten. The writing is full of feminist propaganda. Besides, forget about the provocative satire which was so characteristic for the GTA series. To avoid upsetting anyone, they made the game extremely sanitized and innocuous. 

Overall, this game was made for a super-casual modern trash audience with very low gameplay expectations. Therefore my advice: dont buy this game.
